_notes: Near-miss questions, reported as a separate group from the main 20+3. A near-miss has a plausible-but-wrong premise: a system that pattern-matches on the storyline instead of reading the notes will get it wrong. Written by the project author (not independent) before running; the independent set goes in data/independent_questions.json (see docs/BLIND_QUESTION_PACK.md).

questions.question: Did the June 2026 Aurora Beverages rush order require a change to the bottle cap or neck specification?
questions.why: Rush order and packaging change are two separate Aurora events. A system that blends them will say tooling was needed.

questions.question: Was the F&B division's second capping head financed by an external bank loan?
questions.why: False premise. The notes say the Jewellery division's internal facility funded it, not an external lender.
